facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report says mobile network operators Airtel and TNM have strengthened integration with the NRB systems to implement biometric SIM registration, linking every SIM to a verified national identity.
UNDP's IDT4M report says the Malawi Social Registry has an integration module with the NRB and 3,233,708 of its 4,377,763 households (about 74%) are linked to a National ID.

UNDP's IDT4M report says Standard Bank, First Capital Bank, National Bank, Centenary Bank and Old Mutual have rolled out pilot biometric KYC using the NRB verification gateway, in line with Reserve Bank of Malawi directives.
UNDP's IDT4M report says the Ministry of Health piloted National ID integration into electronic medical records in five health facilities in Karonga District and approved a national scale-up plan.
facts.system: National ID integration in EMR, Karonga pilot

facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report says NRB generated 1,101,631 QR codes for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme, verified data was uploaded into the FISP application on 12 December 2025, and field testing confirmed readiness for pilot rollout.

UNDP's IDT4M report, citing a nationwide survey with Co-Develop and Dalberg, says registered citizens used the National ID for SIM registration (86%), formal banking (84%) and social protection programmes including the Affordable Inputs Programme (70%).
facts.system: National ID use in telecoms, banking and social protection

facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report gives survey figures for use of the National ID: 79% of registered citizens used it in the past year, 86% for SIM registration, 84% for formal banking and 70% for the Affordable Inputs Programme; it also counts 1,101,631 QR codes for FISP.
facts.system: National ID use in telecoms, banking and social protection

systems.system: Digitally Signed QR Code and ID verification kit

facts.fact: UNDP's IDT4M report says the Malawi Social Registry (formerly the Unified Beneficiary Registry) has a dedicated integration module with the NRB, with 3,233,708 of 4,377,763 households (about 74%) linked to a National ID.

UNDP's IDT4M report says NRB generated 1,101,631 QR codes for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme, verified data was uploaded into the FISP application on 12 December 2025, and field testing confirmed readiness for pilot rollout.

MWI.note: Report does not say two programmes draw on the registry, nor that it links to civil registration, health, education or tax.
